products.name: Samsung 8 kg AI Wash top-load washing machine
products.summary: Lift the soft-closing glass lid, pull out the detergent box and look into the diamond drum, then place it in your home at its real size.
products.arTip: Tap the lid to open it
products.sizeNote: Body only, 98.8 cm tall; with the lid open it is about 134 cm
specs: Digital Inverter, 10 years on the motor
AI Wash, Super Speed, Ecobubble, BubbleStorm, Dual Storm pulsator
AI Wash, Normal, Quick Wash, Delicates, Bedding, Jeans, Energy Saving, Rinse+Spin, Tub Clean, Downloaded
Wi-Fi, SmartThings, AI Energy Mode, Smart Check
Delay End, Child Lock, Auto Restart, Monsoon, Intensive Wash, Power Tub Clean
2 years on the machine, 10 years on the motor

hotspots.title: AI Wash
hotspots.text: Senses the weight and softness of the load, then suggests the water level, the agitation and the wash and rinse times.

hotspots.title: Ecobubble
hotspots.text: Cleans with up to 25% less energy and 11% less water, and BubbleStorm helps detergent get into the fabric 2.5x faster (Samsung's tests).

hotspots.title: Magic Filter
hotspots.text: A dual mesh at the front and back gathers lint, fluff and particles from the wash, and it opens 180 degrees to empty.

hotspots.title: Soft closing lid
hotspots.text: A damper lets the lid shut slowly, gently and quietly, and the tempered glass lets you see the wash without lifting it.

fit.note: From Samsung's user manual: keep the machine 10 cm from each adjacent wall. The lid swings up and back: with it open, this model is about 134 cm tall (the opening angle is estimated), so keep 36 cm free above it.
